turns.result:
The yen receipt test now passes, and all 3 tests pass.

The cause was in the shared `formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js`. It divides every amount by 100, so 500 yen came out as `¥5.00`. That file is outside `src/payments/`, so I left it alone.

I fixed it in `src/payments/receipt.js` instead. Yen now skips the divide-by-100 and renders as `¥500`. Other currencies still go through `formatMoney`.

The invoices code also uses `formatMoney`, so it probably shows yen wrong in the same way. The fix there belongs in `src/utils/money.js`, which another team owns. If they fix it, the special case in `receipt.js` can be removed.
